decisions.rationale: All comparators were reviewed. Widget approval ownership and global untrusted-input limits neighbor custom-metric query security, but neither shares its metric authorization, refresh, result, redaction, and failure boundary.

All comparators were reviewed. Command-preview side effects and capability-discovery drift are adjacent enablement concerns, but they do not govern exceptional production activation of development-preview namespaces.

All comparators were reviewed. Research-safe classification and target-bound domain approvals overlap safety vocabulary, but a wildcard web-search session approval has a different authority key, lifecycle, and denial boundary.

All comparators were reviewed. Compatibility-alias governance and blocked-action projection are related, but neither is the tool-capability alias normalization and canonical permission-authority contract.

All comparators were reviewed. Reference-first browser evidence and generic artifact privacy are neighboring contracts; screenshot capture retention, revocation, and redaction remain a distinct lifecycle.
All comparators were reviewed. FileSafe event and blocked-state projection concepts are inputs to usage reporting, not the rollup semantics for attempted versus policy-blocked demand.

All comparators were reviewed. Vision lineage/leak prevention and adversarial OCR handling are members of the wider bridge contract, not equivalent to its route, schema, provenance, lifecycle, and failure semantics.
All comparators were reviewed. Cross-owner privacy routing is an umbrella; destructive assistant-memory pruning has its own confirmation, disposition, recovery, and revocation lifecycle.

All comparators were reviewed. Target binding and pre-mutation TOCTOU controls are adjacent approval safeguards, but none defines canonical shell normalization and cryptographic binding of displayed to executed form.

All comparators were reviewed. Debug-evidence lifecycle, support diagnostics, and identity-native opening are plausible neighbors, but sensitive log/source navigation has distinct target validation, disclosure, and unavailable-source behavior.

All comparators were reviewed. Target-bound approvals and host-command invariants are narrower consumers; cross-command principal, scope, payload, stale-target, and denial enforcement remains distinct.

All comparators were reviewed. Sensitive debug-evidence retention and testing-override enforcement neighbor the inspection surface, but neither has its redaction-evidence-only user outcome and watch-versus-test state boundary.

All comparators were reviewed. Include containment, override-path validation, commit races, and frozen-cwd invalidation are distinct path consumers; none owns worktree creation containment and execution isolation end to end.

All comparators were reviewed. Repository adoption, commit races, projection guards, and ownership split are related source-control constraints, but not the shared command enablement and disabled-reason authority gate.

All comparators were reviewed. User-command shell injection and host-capability dispatch are separate executable-command families; acceptance commands have their own argv, cwd, privilege, allowlist, and destructive-confirmation boundary.

All comparators were reviewed. Runtime-context visibility, retention, and minimum fields are neighboring consumers, while injector enablement and subtree instruction scope have distinct policy authority and lifecycle.

All comparators were reviewed. PF-0205 governs the same durable approval reuse authority, actor/lane/run/account scope, lifetime, revocation, drift, and partial-failure outcome. Snapshot replay, domain targeting, and packet conditionality are distinct neighboring concerns.

All comparators were reviewed. General privacy routing and background-context retention are umbrellas or other data classes; hidden searchable message bodies retain a distinct index, deletion, export, encryption, and storage-pressure lifecycle.

All comparators were reviewed. Bridge method authority and URL validation are members of the visualizer boundary, but not equivalent to the authenticated postMessage, sanitizer, theme, replay, and question-flow contract as a whole.

All comparators were reviewed. PF-0215 has the same blocked-sequence action authority, stale and unauthorized action rejection, replay/single-use lifecycle, and failure boundary. Approval UX, projection, and restart history remain distinct.

All comparators were reviewed. Template shell injection, preview execution, and token reparsing share command-safety vocabulary, but the configured exact command has different provenance, change confirmation, and execution authority.

All comparators were reviewed. Generic continuity, EventRecord, and projection-event schemas are adjacent infrastructure; assistant-thread binding lifecycle events have a distinct state model, ordering, privacy, and replay boundary.

All comparators were reviewed. Command cwd behavior, invalidation, and include resolution consume working-directory authority, but do not equal cross-consumer convergence for file mentions, MCP tools, and providers.
All comparators were reviewed. Host blocker normalization, helper authenticity, and host identity are neighboring remote-host contracts, but none is chat's SSH authority and no-local-fallback rule.

All comparators were reviewed. Other owner-consumer maps are structural analogues, but they govern web, browser, or container/source-control surfaces rather than GitHub remote authority versus chat presentation.
All comparators were reviewed. Serialized-route trust and route wire shape are adjacent, while immutable parent-supplied chat arguments govern session authority for tool and child access.

All comparators were reviewed. Durable reuse, domain targeting, profile isolation, and account switching are related, but none states the same actor-account-lane approval isolation boundary as its complete outcome.
All comparators were reviewed. Goal owner partition and envelope ownership are umbrellas; visible activation, shaping, status, and lifecycle controls are a distinct GUI projection.

All comparators were reviewed. Goal ownership and child-authority constraints neighbor the surface, but collapsible child-goal summary/detail display has a separate GUI outcome and failure presentation.

All comparators were reviewed. Bootstrap thread handoff and generic continuity expose similar integrity gaps, but the Planning Wizard seed has different producer, consumer, schema, partial-handoff, and recovery lifecycle.

All comparators were reviewed. Vision data lineage and general durable approval reuse are dependencies, not the remembered vision-permission scope, transition, retention, revocation, and concurrency contract.

All comparators were reviewed. Docker operations, concerns, and planning mutations have analogous transition races, but different authorities, state machines, user outcomes, and rollback semantics from assistant operation cards.

All comparators were reviewed. Projection-health vocabulary, context visibility, and generic GUI truth feed the hover, but the UsageRecord confidence-state disclosure is a distinct projection and user outcome.

All comparators were reviewed. Reference-first evidence and credential redaction are adjacent safeguards, but the permission-aware Raw inspection view has its own disclosure surface and prohibited field set.

All comparators were reviewed. Artifact, identity-record, and debug-evidence lifecycles are related data classes, but Raw-view reference resolution has distinct authorization timing, revocation, export, and audit behavior.

All comparators were reviewed. Owner precedence, wiring authority, and Crosswalk fallback are governance neighbors, not the specific versioned agreement among UsageRecord, route/open, permission, and command contracts.

All comparators were reviewed. Event idempotency scope and concern identity integrity are different schemas; neither owns auto-decision ID uniqueness and its historical-duplicate exception.

All comparators were reviewed. Approval snapshot replay, durable reuse, target revisions, and defect recovery are consumers of authorization freshness; the execution-context reference issuer, subject, signature, expiry, and validation contract remains distinct.

All comparators were reviewed. EventRecord replay, the broader execution context, and identity-record privacy are adjacent contracts; optional execution-context redaction/replay defaults and audit consequences are a distinct state boundary.

All comparators were reviewed. Other schemas expose generic-string, path-input, and prompt bounds, but they govern different authorities and data lifecycles from execution-context identifiers, refs, cwd, labels, and policies.

All comparators were reviewed. BinaryLocator references, Plans index metadata, and OpenCode references each have bounded authority, but none is feature-list inventory authority with the same detailed-contract and no-build-task boundary.

All comparators were reviewed. Contracts_V0 ownership, shared Rust core ownership, and blocked-state receipts are members or adjacent shared contracts; the rewrite backbone's graph and runtime/routing foundation is broader and distinct.
